top_signals.title: Stocks, Bonds Fall as CPI Data Fuel Fed-Hike Bets: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks and bonds fell as consumer prices climbed at the fastest pace in five months, reinforcing concerns the Federal Reserve will keep rates higher for longer amid elevated oil prices.

top_signals.title: Aramco Headquarters Hit as Houthis Widen Saudi Arabia Attacks
top_signals.summary: Iran-backed Houthis launched missile and drone attacks across Saudi Arabia, hitting oil giant Saudi Aramco’s headquarters, as well several cities in the kingdom. Abeer Abu Omar reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
